🫏 New post ready 📚 List · siblings · 8 slides “pieces of home you didn't have to pack” 📝 Slides
1. pieces of home you didn't have to pack 2. folding tea towels in neat thirds before putting them away, because you watched them do it every sunday. 3. calling from aisle four at seven in the evening to ask which rice to buy, and they answer on ring one. 4. writing their number under emergency contact on a form, without texting first to ask if it's fine. 5. a four-second voice note sent on a wednesday that is just the kettle whistling, with no hello. 6. finding a crumpled ten-pound note tucked in your coat pocket with a scrawl that says get dinner. 7. having someone who remembers the year the roof leaked, so you never have to explain why you are like this. 8. save this for an evening when a new flat feels a little too quiet.
✍️ Caption
the miles do not matter as much when you share the same habits. my sister taught me to check the stove twice before leaving, and i still do it every morning. save this for the next time you unpack a box in a quiet room. #siblings #oldersiblings #siblinglove #brotherandsister
